author: Walker Industries
name: XRUIOS Plagues Worker
description: A secured Plagues worker (Notary anti-tamper + Eclipse encrypted channel). Singular = one cross-platform worker (default); Cross Platform = one worker that auto-switches Windows/Linux bodies at runtime.

choices.description: Singular: ONE worker, assumed cross-platform (the same functions on every OS). One build, no branching. The default.
Cross Platform: ONE worker that auto-switches between a Windows body and a Linux body at runtime. One build runs on both.

capability.description: Name of the first [SeaOfDirac] capability (must be a valid C# identifier).
